ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobe regions to 25% low-intensity black pixels localized on the margins and internal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black banding along leading and trailing edges; multiple high-contrast black circular clusters located medially on both lobes; a distinct diagonal low-intensity band on the interior right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the background water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the lateral tips; right terminal tip exhibits an upward vertical sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast dark circular/annular clusters; dense concentration on the left lobe and dispersed clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal linear pixel disruption extending from the inner right lobe toward the trailing edge, breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring on both lobes and a prominent linear rake-like mark on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip shows a more pronounced upward hook-like geometry compared to the left tip.
